notes: The retention of the Wazuh indexer (kubernetes/apps/security/wazuh/README.md, 'Retention'). The job builds one ISM policy of tnwks for each stream below, under an ID of its own: the shipped policies roll over only at 20 GB for each primary shard, so at a low volume they delete nothing, and the Setup plugin writes them again at each start (wazuh-indexer-plugins v5.0.0-rc2, docs/ref/modules/setup/retention.md).

Each policy rolls over at rollover_age, or at the shipped size or count, whichever comes first, and deletes a backing index at its delete age, counted from the creation of the index. So an event stays from the delete age less rollover_age up to the delete age.

Open decision, at the design gate of the retention: whether 90 days is a floor (delete at 90 days plus one rollover period, here 120 days) or a ceiling (delete at 90 days). delete_age holds the floor, the recommended value. One edit of delete_age changes the policies of events, findings, raw events and active responses.
metrics_delete_age keeps the agent snapshots for 30 to 60 days.
The patterns are those of the shipped policies at v5.0.0-rc2 (plugins/setup/src/main/resources/policies/), and priority 1 puts each policy above the shipped one (priority 0) for a new backing index.
